static_traits.name: Zhang Hao
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends,but has not yet shared with them one's lack of confidence and sense of inadequacy;interactions with friends are affected by Decreased confidence
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness;no past counseling or therapy experience;no history of similar psychological issues
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly,with fairly organized thinking,able to notice and discuss own thoughts;Neutral attitude,cooperativeness Good,capable of self-Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: After friends have not found the jokes I told funny,developing a sense of inadequacy and Self-doubt about my ability to 'make others laugh';the problem worsened into fear of being judged by others,believing I am not good at comedy,with avoidance and insecurity appearing in Humor-related social situations.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of inferiority are affecting self-esteem and social interaction;hoping to identify and challenge catastrophizing and negative predictions through counseling,forming a more realistic and balanced view,thereby improving confidence and social experience.

core_beliefs: I am not a humorous person
I am not good enough(not being able to make others laugh means I failed)

special_situations.event: At a gathering with friends,the joke I told have not triggered laughter
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my joke has not made friends laugh,it proves I am not humorous,I failed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing the frequency of attempting Humor in front of friends,avoiding telling jokes again;seeking comfort and approval from friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not funny at all,I will never be good at comedy

special_situations.event: In relaxed recreational Social situations with friends,when interaction and Humor are needed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I try Humor,others will judge me,look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying not to attract attention,laughing along with others in agreement,to avoid standing out
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am embarrassing and will evaluate me negatively

special_situations.event: When thinking of telling a joke or seeing others laughing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must make everyone find it funny,otherwise it means I am not capable;if I try again,I will surely embarrass myself
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Staying Silence in relevant situations,avoiding speaking up,Reduced social exposure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I say it, the scene will be awkward and everyone will go silent

special_situations.event: Recalling the failed joke-telling experience each time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One failure equals me being completely not good at comedy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-censoring,avoiding attempting Humor in front of friends,seeking reassurance to reduce Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This shows I do not have the ability for Humor

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted by friends,and for my Humor and social value to be recognized
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged, humiliated, and rejected by others
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of security and intact self-esteem by avoiding Humor performance and reducing self-disclosure

object_relations.self_representation: Someone easily embarrassed,a judged person lacking a sense of Humor
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges/people who may mock and negate oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites setting a goal of trying again to tell a small joke among friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The unconscious understands the counselor as an authority figure who will push them to expose themselves to embarrassing situations, thereby presuming negative outcomes (transference: negative expectations of others' reactions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopt a gentle,supportive tone,first acknowledge their tension and worry,then break the goal into manageable small steps,emphasizing that imperfection is allowed and gradual trying is encouraged.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When scenes are mentioned where friends might 'not find it funny' or 'judge oneself'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Projecting inner self-criticism and shame experiences as others' negative evaluations(believing others will surely look down on oneself)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gently correct with an empathic tone,invite them to distinguish facts from speculation,encourage evidence-gathering and multiple possibilities,avoid confrontational questioning.

manifestations: Unmarried and Living alone;avoiding expression in Humor-related social scenes,feeling 'not accepted' and 'not belonging to the circle'
outcomes: Increased sensitivity to others' evaluations and rising Anxiety

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: In the session, repeatedly assuming that others will evaluate him negatively (such as 'they will think I am awkward')
Understanding inner shame and Self-denial experiences as others' unanimous view

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and introspection abilities, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: When discussing social goals, is cautious and conservative, tending to set very small attempts to avoid making mistakes
Overly caring about how others view one's Humor performance

positive_force: Has several close friends as potential support resources
Work performance not yet affected,basic life functioning stable
Willing to seek help and engage in counseling,with some self-awareness and Reflection ability
negative_force: Marked cognitive biases such as catastrophizing,predicting the future,overgeneralization,black-and-white thinking
Highly sensitive to others' evaluations, tending to seek external recognition and reassurance
Avoidance and self-censorship in Humor-related social situations,leading to declining self-esteem and poorer interaction quality

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding speaking and Humor expression in Humor-related Social situations,and lowering one's presence by echoing others
antecedent: At relaxed, entertaining gatherings or social activities with friends
When thinking of telling a joke or seeing others laugh
Recalling the previous experience of jokes not yet considered funny
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic prediction of embarrassing oneself again,the black-and-white belief of 'one failure = completely not capable',and high sensitivity to others' judgment
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential shame and negative evaluation,maintaining short-term security and Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Lowered self-esteem,impaired social interaction,further reduced Humor expression and confidence,forming a negative cycle
